entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The present application has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Telco P.S.
Case No.28 of 2023, registered for the offence under Sections 414, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned J.M., Jamshedpur.
3. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that this applicant has been roped in this case on the basis of being a caretaker of the vehicle in question.
The applicant is only a caretaker and he has no concern with the ownership of the vehicle and any forgery committed.
So far as the manufacturing of the documents is concerned.
Whatever has been done it has been done by the owner of the vehicle.
On the above basis, prayer for anticipatory bail has been made.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
5. Considering the above facts, the applicant is granted privilege of anticipatory bail.

Hence, in the event of his/her arrest or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, he shall Pankaj Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42866634/
1 be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M., Jamshedpur, in connection with Telco P.S. Case No.28 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) Cr. P.C. and also on the condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his/her Aadhaar Card and also submit his/her mobile number before the learned court below which she/he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
